{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}装腔作势？！{PART_001}好家伙，这下还是你更胜一筹！

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Lesser!{PART_001}Doesn't quite roll off the tongue,{PART_002}but I reckon it fits!

frames.source: {SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}Hm.{PART_001}No.{PART_002}Not specific enough.{PART_003}I fear we have been over this.

{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}对，我开始有种似曾相识的感觉了……

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}I do not!{PART_001}Plus,{PART_002}you say that as if it's a bad thing.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}才没有！{PART_001}再说，{PART_002}你讲得好像这还是坏事。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Well,{PART_001}is 'greater' a good choice for signal -32 or not??
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}那，{PART_001}把信号 -32 叫“大于”到底好不好？？

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Could someone,{PART_001}uh,{PART_002}reiterate that word for their friendly astronomer pal?
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}谁能，{PART_001}呃，{PART_002}再给你们那位和善的天文学家朋友解释一遍这个词？
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}我不认识什么天文学家朋友。
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}别这样！{PART_001}“命题”到底是什么意思？
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}也是，不过{PART_001}人家好像不太爱说话。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Pardon my intrusion,{PART_001}but I believe you have it backwards.{PART_002}It should be '(' or am I mistaken?
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}抱歉打断一下，{PART_001}但我觉得你弄反了。{PART_002}应该是“(”，还是我理解错了？

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}You're so polite,{PART_001}Collins.{PART_002}Just tell 'em they screwed up!
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}你真客气，{PART_001}柯林斯。{PART_002}直接告诉人家搞错了就行！
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}哎，{PART_001}反正已经写进记录了。{PART_002}来不及了！！

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Good call!{PART_001}This one was 7, simple as that.

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}I hate it.{PART_001}It's too rigid.{PART_002}Unlike anything we've encountered before.

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Well,{PART_001}it works for now, so I like it.

frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}说得好！{PART_001}这个就是 7，就这么简单。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}I hate it.{PART_001}It's too rigid.{PART_002}Unlike anything we've encountered before.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}我讨厌这个。{PART_001}太死板了。{PART_002}和之前见过的东西都不一样。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Well,{PART_001}it works for now, so I like it.
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}Their number system does not use the digits 8 or 9.{PART_001}It is not decimal,{PART_002}but octal.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}他们的数字系统不用 8 和 9。{PART_001}这不是十进制，{PART_002}而是八进制。
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}随便吧。{PART_001}巴蒂斯塔，{PART_002}就算对你来说，这也太较真了。
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}别人还用过更难听的词形容我。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}As in floating point numbers.{PART_001}The translator impresses me.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}就是浮点数。{PART_001}这位翻译员让我刮目相看。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Well that's rare.{PART_001}How come I never impress you?
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}嘿，真稀奇。{PART_001}我怎么从没让你刮目相看过？

frames.source: {SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}I think that is for you to answer.{PART_001}Hehe.
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}Mmm.{PART_001}You have made a programmer happy today.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}嗯。{PART_001}你今天让一个程序员开心了。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Octal,{PART_001}jeez,{PART_002}what squares you are.{PART_003}The whole lot of you's.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}八进制，{PART_001}天啊，{PART_002}你们可真够古板的。{PART_003}一个个都是。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}'X',{PART_001}nice and simple.{PART_002}I take it you mean for multiplication?
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}“X”，{PART_001}简单明了。{PART_002}你是想让它表示乘法吧？

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Add.{PART_001}Or maybe add previous?{PART_002}Collins,{PART_003}what do you figure?
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}加。{PART_001}或者叫“加上前项”？{PART_002}柯林斯，{PART_003}你觉得呢？

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}I figure 'add' works just fine.{PART_001}Adding the previous numbers seems to be how the meteor formats mathematical expressions.{PART_002}So add previous may be redundant.{PART_003}Just their grammar at work is all.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}我觉得“加”就很好。{PART_001}陨石似乎是把前面的数字相加，以此写出数学表达式。{PART_002}所以“加上前项”可能有些多余。{PART_003}这只是他们的语法在起作用。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Hm.{PART_001}I see.{PART_002}Add previous just gels better in my lobes.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}嗯。{PART_001}懂了。{PART_002}可我脑子就是觉得“加前项”更顺。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Plus, huh.{PART_001}First number plus second number.{PART_002}Yeah,{PART_003}I see it.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}加上，是吧。{PART_001}第一个数加上第二个数。{PART_002}对，{PART_003}我懂了。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}I agree.{PART_001}It seems to be a good fit for now.{PART_002}We'll see if it remains consistent.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}我同意。{PART_001}目前看来很合适。{PART_002}还要看它能不能保持一致。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}As do I.{PART_001}It's been consistent so far.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}我也喜欢。{PART_001}目前用法一直很一致。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}You could shorten it to just '=' if you desire.{PART_001}Some symbols are permitted in the dictionary.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}想缩短的话，可以直接写成“=”。{PART_001}词典允许使用某些符号。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Whaddya mean "in what way"?{PART_001}$animA1{PLAYER_NAME} means "and" to group some stuff together!
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}什么叫“哪种意思”？{PART_001}$animA1{PLAYER_NAME}说的就是把一些东西并列起来的“与”！

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}With--{PART_001}what an elegant word to associate multiple objects!
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}“与……一起”——{PART_001}多么优雅的词，能把多个对象联系起来！

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Just to clarify,{PART_001}I don't think -2 represents an "apple."{PART_002}I hope that didn't lead you astray,{PART_003}{PLAYER_NAME}...
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}先说明一下，{PART_001}我不认为 -2 表示“苹果”。{PART_002}希望这没有把你带偏，{PART_003}{PLAYER_NAME}……

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}So far.{PART_001}That's the key.{PART_002}It works for now,{PART_003}but we can revisit it if its use is more flexible than that.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}目前是。{PART_001}关键就在这里。{PART_002}现在能用，{PART_003}但如果它的用法比这更灵活，我们可以再改。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}As in skipping over the prior signal.{PART_001}Interesting analysis.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}也就是跳过前一个信号。{PART_001}这个分析挺有意思。
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}空间？{PART_001}是指外太空？{PART_002}天文学家赞成。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}And if you mean it to mean space as in formatting,{PART_001}then the linguist approves.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}如果你指的是排版里的空格，{PART_001}那语言学家也赞成。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}$animA0It is to separate words.{PART_001}$animC3Dr. Bautista disallowed spaces in the dictionary for some reason,{PART_002}a good reason I'm sure.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}$animA0它用来分隔单词。{PART_001}$animC3巴蒂斯塔博士不许词典里出现空格，至于为什么我也不清楚，{PART_002}当然，他肯定有充分的理由。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}$animC0Parsing words with spaces would be troublesome.{PART_001}Imagine inputting 2 spaces rather than 1.{PART_002}$animB1The compiler would struggle to parse it as we wished.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}$animC0解析带空格的词会很麻烦。{PART_001}要是有人输入了 2 个空格，而不是 1 个呢？{PART_002}$animB1编译器就很难照我们的意思解析。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Question mark?{PART_001}{PLAYER_NAME},{PART_002}is that just your filler word while you land on a good name for it?
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}问号？{PART_001}{PLAYER_NAME}，{PART_002}这只是你还没想出好名字之前拿来凑数的词吗？

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Ans?{PART_001}As in "answer?"{PART_002}Gee {PLAYER_NAME},{PART_003}good catch!{PART_004}I'm surprised you beat me to that one!
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Ans？{PART_001}是“answer”的缩写？{PART_002}哎呀，{PLAYER_NAME}，{PART_003}抓得好！{PART_004}没想到这次你比我还快！

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}A, S, D, F... Ohh. This is gibberish. Got it.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}哦，原来就是键盘左手边那几个键，是乱打的。明白了。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}I figured out what ASDF stands for.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}我想好这个名字该怎么解释了。
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Aliens Sometimes Deliver Fortunes——“外星人有时会带来好运”。
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}哦哦哦哦哦。{PART_001}我好像弄懂了。{PART_002}对。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Bautista, do you know what IDK is?
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}巴蒂斯塔，你知道这个名字是什么意思吗？

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}So "IDK" is your temporary name, for when we are still figuring out a new signal's meaning. I see.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}所以“IDK”是暂定名，用在我们还没弄清新信号含义的时候。明白了。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}I'd certainly consider 600 million BC to be quite ancient.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}公元前 6 亿年当然称得上远古。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Evoked by the deepest of our negative experiences.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}悲伤源自我们最痛苦的经历。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Happiness--{PART_001}an individual's positive emotional state.{PART_002}Is it universal to intelligent life?
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}快乐——{PART_001}一个人的积极情绪状态。{PART_002}所有智慧生命都有这种感受吗？

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}This is only something we could translate,{PART_001}we could understand,{PART_002}if we viewed the world in the same way--{PART_003}in terms of the good and the bad and the in between.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}只有当我们看待世界的方式与他们相同，{PART_001}我们才能翻译、{PART_002}才能理解这个词——{PART_003}把一切分为好、坏，以及两者之间。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}A pit in my stomach tells me that when Bautista says "ugly",{PART_001}my name will somehow find its way comin' soon after.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}巴蒂斯塔一说“丑”，{PART_001}我就有种不祥的预感，他马上就会扯到我。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}I've learned this past year that there's 2 different kinds of good.{PART_001}$animA4There's good in morality,{PART_002}and good in capability.{PART_003}$animA0Which is it here,{PART_004}{PLAYER_NAME}?
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}过去一年我才知道，“好”其实有两种。{PART_001}$animA4一种是品德好，{PART_002}一种是能力强。{PART_003}$animA0这里是哪一种，{PART_004}{PLAYER_NAME}？

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}$animC5You suspect that {SIG_N129}'s think and feel and love,{PART_001}just like us.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}$animC5你觉得{SIG_N129}也会思考、感受和爱，{PART_001}就像我们一样。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}And yet they're creatures totally different from us,{PART_001}$animA5from very far away.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}可他们又是与我们完全不同的生物，{PART_001}$animA5来自无比遥远的地方。

frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}不对。{PART_001}宇宙太大了。{PART_002}这一定是别的东西。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Information that is "known" is information judged to be within one's awareness.{PART_001}It requires perspective,{PART_002}which is unique among the Meteor's vocabulary.{PART_003}Our shared language is evolving.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}所谓“已知”的信息，是指一个人意识范围内的信息。{PART_001}这需要主观视角，{PART_002}在陨石的词汇中很特别。{PART_003}我们共同的语言正在演变。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}A word to note a moment or phase in time.{PART_001}I think that fits perfectly here.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}一个表示某个时刻或时间阶段的词。{PART_001}我觉得用在这里正合适。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}After,{PART_001}huh?{PART_002}When all this is said and done,{PART_003}I wonder what's next for us?
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}之后，{PART_001}是吧？{PART_002}等这一切都尘埃落定，{PART_003}不知道我们以后会怎样？

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}The past has happened,{PART_001}the present is fleeting.{PART_002}The future is the only thing we can affect.{PART_003}So the only way to go is forward.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}过去已经发生，{PART_001}现在转瞬即逝。{PART_002}未来是唯一还能被我们改变的东西。{PART_003}所以只能向前走。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Current,{PART_001}huh?{PART_002}You think they're talkin' about now?{PART_003}We'll see if it fits,{PART_004}but we've gotta wait for the future for that.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}当前，{PART_001}是吧？{PART_002}你觉得他们说的是现在？{PART_003}还得看看是否合适，{PART_004}不过得等到未来才能知道了。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}The present is all we have.{PART_001}It is only place we can make decisions and take actions.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}我们拥有的只有现在。{PART_001}只有在此刻，我们才能作出决定、采取行动。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}My old man used to say "the past is the only place you can revisit."
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}我爸以前常说：“过去是唯一可以故地重游的地方。”

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}You think they were talkin' about the previous transmission then?{PART_001}Maybe that explains those suspiciously easy ones...
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}那你觉得他们说的是上一次传输？{PART_001}也许这就能解释那几个简单得可疑的题了……

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}I had similar thoughts on that word myself,{PART_001}{PLAYER_NAME}.

frames.translation: {SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}中位数。{PART_001}数据集的各项指标里，最可恶的一个。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Despicable?{PART_001}That's an awfully expressive word for a  mundane metric.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}可恶？{PART_001}一个平平无奇的指标而已，你这用词也太强烈了。

frames.translation: {SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}计算数据集的中位数，{PART_001}$animB4必须先给数据排序。{PART_002}对计算机来说，{PART_003}排序是一项代价高昂、{PART_004}消耗大量指令的操作。{PART_005}$animB0可恶。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Then that sounds like a pretty good fit!{PART_001}Nice one {PLAYER_NAME}!

frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}——艾伦·埃克斯博士“是”世界上最优秀的天文学家！

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Hey that one's not my fault!{PART_001}It hasn't been catalogued yet!{PART_002}You sure know how to hit where it hurts,{PART_003}Bautista...
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}嘿，这又不是我的错！{PART_001}那个地方还没被编入星表呢！{PART_002}你可真会往痛处戳，{PART_003}巴蒂斯塔……

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}I see you appreciated the vocabulary I shared!{PART_001}I'm pleased to see a linguist's word in the dictionary :)

{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}谁知道。{PART_001}单字符词也许还会再出现。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}I remain doubtful.{PART_001}We're moving away from math and towards language.{PART_002}I fear single character terms are behind us.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}我还是不信。{PART_001}我们正从数学转向语言。{PART_002}恐怕单字符词已经不会再有了。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Alan would've loved to see you enter "Galaxy".
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}艾伦要是看到你输入“银河系”，肯定会很高兴。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}It's hard to fathom the scale of a galaxy.

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Even for you,{PART_001}someone who has studied the Milky Way in such detail?

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}The more I study,{PART_001}the more I struggle to fathom it.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}研究得越多，{PART_001}反而越觉得难以想象。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Their definition is quite vague,{PART_001}but I think this fits best.{PART_002}Supermassive end-stage leftovers from a {SIG_N090},{PART_003}blackhole fits.

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}I don't know what that is,{PART_001}but that's what Alan left in his hypotheses before he left.

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Neutronstar.{PART_001}I'm in agreement.{PART_002}You have the astronomer's approval!

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}I had something a little different,{PART_001}but you match the astronomer's thinking.{PART_002}I'd trust that.

frames.source: {SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}Akers would be proud,{PART_001}if he were here.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}埃克斯要是在，{PART_001}也会为你骄傲。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}If the aliens are defining 'opposite',{PART_001}then I theorize they will use it,{PART_002}to define a word that otherwise would be difficult to define.{PART_003}It will come around somehow.{PART_004}These aliens act with purpose.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}如果外星人在定义“相反”，{PART_001}那我猜他们会用它，{PART_002}去定义一个原本很难定义的词。{PART_003}它迟早会派上用场。{PART_004}这些外星人每一步都有用意。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}The "object" of each Meteor sentence--{PART_001}My exact thoughts,{PART_002}{PLAYER_NAME}!
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}陨石每个句子的“宾语”——{PART_001}和我想的一模一样，{PART_002}{PLAYER_NAME}！

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}$animC4You've come to the same hypothesis,{PART_001}{PLAYER_NAME}!?{PART_002}$animC0That's always validating to see :-)

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Adjectives,{PART_001}descriptor words.{PART_002}Yet another part of speech to add to our dictionary.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}形容词，{PART_001}用于描述的词。{PART_002}词典里又多了一种词性。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Verb!!!!!!!!!!!{PART_001}We can discuss the alien language in meta-linguistic categories!{PART_002}Moving forward,{PART_003}this will only make definitions easier and easier.{PART_004}We will already have a basis on which we can build---
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}动词！！！！！！！！！！！{PART_001}我们可以用元语言层面的分类来讨论外星语言了！{PART_002}以后，{PART_003}定义只会变得越来越容易。{PART_004}我们已经有了可以继续搭建的基础——

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Gee is this really what I sound like Bautista?
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}天啊，巴蒂斯塔，我平时听起来也这样吗？

frames.source: {SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}At least she has coherent analysis to provide.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}至少她的分析还算条理清楚。
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}名词！！！！{PART_001}一种词性！{PART_002}太棒了，实在太棒了！！

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Gee {PLAYER_NAME},{PART_001}let's be more careful with our definitions.{PART_002}She's hurtin' my ears with her excitement...
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}哎呀，{PLAYER_NAME}，{PART_001}下定义还是谨慎点吧。{PART_002}她兴奋得我耳朵都疼了……

frames.source: {SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}Now you know what it is like.
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Hey now what's that supposed to mean!!
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}This is too confusing.{PART_001}Earlier we had a logical OR in signal -31.{PART_002}Now we have this.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}这也太乱了。{PART_001}之前信号 -31 是逻辑或。{PART_002}现在又来一个。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Agreed.{PART_001}Though this OR makes more sense to me.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}同意。{PART_001}不过这个“或”对我来说更好理解。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}We only have humanity to blame for this confusion.
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}We named a logical operation after a common word.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}我们拿日常词语给逻辑运算起了名。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}And you heard it from him first,{PART_001}we can blame you logicians for ruining a normal word!
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}这可是他亲口承认的：{PART_001}一个好好的词，就被你们搞逻辑的毁了！

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Mass!{PART_001}They're measuring matter!{PART_002}Good good good!{PART_003}Great great great!!
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}质量！{PART_001}他们在测量物质！{PART_002}好好好！{PART_003}太好了太好了太好了！！

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Oh yeah.{PART_001}It's baked into the fabric of the universe.{PART_002}About as universal as it gets.
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}当然。{PART_001}它就写在宇宙的基本结构里。{PART_002}再普适不过了。

frames.source: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Which means it's another point of reference between humanity and the aliens.{PART_001}Excellent!!
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}这样人类和外星人就又有了一个共同参照。{PART_001}太好了！！

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Like in the classic "rate = distance / time" equation.{PART_001}Good find, {PLAYER_NAME}!
frames.translation: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}就像经典的“速率 = 距离 / 时间”方程。{PART_001}找得好，{PLAYER_NAME}！

frames.source: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}I feel the need...{PART_001}the need for speed.

{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}“同位素”可以。{PART_001}……{PART_002}很好。{PART_003}……{PART_004}我要关日志了。
